title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Under Policy, Social Influence, and Supply Constraints
description: Simulate how individuals adopt face masks over time in response to social influence, public health policies, information exposure, and market availability, optionally coupled with disease transmission dynamics.

interactions.name: SocialContactTransmission
interactions.description: When two individuals meet at a location, infection may transmit based on disease parameters and whether either or both wear masks, with efficacy modifying transmission probability.

interactions.name: PeerInfluenceOnAdoption
interactions.description: Individuals update mask adoption propensity based on the proportion of masked neighbors and household norms (threshold or weighted influence).

interactions.name: PolicyComplianceAndEnforcement
interactions.description: Authorities set mandates; locations and enforcement resources affect compliance. Individuals decide to comply based on propensity, perceived enforcement, and fines.

interactions.name: MarketTransactionForMasks
interactions.description: Individuals attempt to purchase masks from retailers subject to stock, price, and income; retailers restock and adjust price to demand and lead times.

interactions.name: MediaInformationExposure
interactions.description: Media outlets broadcast messages that shift risk perception, trust, and beliefs, which in turn affect mask adoption decisions.

interactions.name: ExperienceDrivenLearning
interactions.description: Individuals who experience infection (self or close contact) update risk perception upward, increasing likelihood of mask adoption.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Proportion of individuals wearing a mask at each timestep.

metrics.name: time_to_target_adoption
metrics.description: Days to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: adoption_rate_by_location_type
metrics.description: Share of masked individuals observed within each location type.

metrics.name: cumulative_infections
metrics.description: Total number of infections over the simulation period.

metrics.name: peak_prevalence
metrics.description: Maximum fraction of the population simultaneously infectious.

metrics.name: effective_reproduction_number_Re
metrics.description: Estimated average number of secondary infections per infectious individual over time.

metrics.name: noncompliance_rate_under_mandate
metrics.description: Fraction of individuals not wearing a mask when a mandate is in place.

metrics.name: stockout_frequency
metrics.description: Proportion of days retailers have zero stock available.

metrics.name: average_mask_price
metrics.description: Average retail price of masks over time, weighted by sales.

metrics.name: policy_costs_collected
metrics.description: Total fines collected due to noncompliance.

validation_criteria.name: adoption_convergence
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate change is below 0.5 percentage points over the last 7 days.

validation_criteria.name: epidemic_control
validation_criteria.description: Effective reproduction number Re remains below 1.0 for at least 14 consecutive days.

validation_criteria.name: calibration_fit
validation_criteria.description: If empirical adoption data is provided, RMSE between simulated and observed adoption curves is below a predefined threshold.
